question: Which airport has been voted the best international airport in the world for 2025 at India’s Best Awards by Travel+Leisure?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Singapore Changi Airport.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Singapore Changi Airport was voted the best international airport in the world for 2025.**
 
• **The recognition was conferred at India’s Best Awards by Travel+Leisure.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Singapore Changi Airport topped the rankings for overall travel experience.**
 
• **Readers rated it highest for comfort, facilities, and efficiency.**
 
• **The airport is known for indoor gardens, sky-lit interiors and leisure attractions.**
 
• **The award was based on global reader voting under India’s Best Awards 2025.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **India’s Best Awards**__ – An annual Travel+Leisure initiative recognising excellence in travel and hospitality through reader votes.
 
• Changi Airport features the world’s tallest indoor waterfall, butterfly gardens, and art-filled terminals.
 
• Facilities include transit hotels, sleeping pods, diverse dining options, and global retail brands.
 
• The airport is widely regarded as a destination in itself rather than only a transit hub.
